mapper.select: select sub_id, user_id, media_id, notify_channel, notified, status, create_time, update_time from km_user_subscription where user_id = #{userId} and media_id = #{mediaId} limit 1

select s.sub_id, s.user_id, s.media_id, s.notify_channel, s.notified, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, m.media_id as m_media_id, m.title as m_title, m.poster_path as m_poster_path, m.poster_local_url as m_poster_local_url, m.release_date as m_release_date, m.media_type as m_media_type, m.region as m_region, m.status as m_status, coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) as m_online_date from km_user_subscription s join km_media m on m.media_id = s.media_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.status = '0' order by m_online_date asc
select sub_id, user_id, media_id, notify_channel, notified, status, create_time, update_time from km_user_subscription where media_id = #{mediaId} and status = '0' and notified = '0'
select sub_id, user_id, media_id, notify_channel, notified, status, create_time, update_time from km_user_subscription where media_id = #{mediaId} and status = '0'

select s.media_id as mediaId, m.title as title, m.media_type as mediaType, count(*) as subCount, sum(s.notified = '1') as notifiedCount, max(s.update_time) as lastTime from km_user_subscription s join km_media m on m.media_id = s.media_id where s.status = '0' group by s.media_id, m.title, m.media_type order by subCount desc, lastTime desc

select s.sub_id as subId, s.user_id as userId, mem.username as username, mem.nickname as nickname, s.media_id as mediaId, m.title as title, s.status as status, s.create_time as createTime, s.update_time as updateTime from km_user_subscription s left join km_member mem on mem.member_id = s.user_id join km_media m on m.media_id = s.media_id order by s.update_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into km_user_subscription (user_id, media_id, notify_channel, notified, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{mediaId}, ifnull(#{notifyChannel},'site,email'), '0', '0', sysdate(), sysdate())
